summary: Iter 8 — Verified Admin Property Map popup + PHED map detail fix for THS-0001 (Didar Nagar). Backend pytest 5/5 PASS (/app/backend/tests/test_map_phed_iter8.py, junit: /app/test_reports/pytest/iter8.xml): (a) anonymous GET /api/map/properties -> 403; (b) anonymous GET /api/phed/property/{id} -> 403; (c) admin GET /api/map/properties?colony=Didar%20Nagar returns THS-0001 marker enriched with phed_consumer_id='PROV-THS-0001', phed_consumer_name='Verify Owner 1', phed_consumer_mobile present; no _id/ObjectId leakage; legacy MC fields (property_id, owner_name, mobile, ward, phed_survey_status) preserved; (d) admin GET /api/phed/property/6abd2d41-... returns property (THS-0001), linked consumers list (>=1), and survey with status='Submitted' + reference containing 'PL0001'; no _id in property/consumers/survey; (e) properties without a linked PHED consumer simply omit phed_consumer_id (no misrepresentation). Frontend Playwright (desktop 1920x1080, admin/Phed#Admin2026!, town Thanesar): opened /admin/map, selected Didar Nagar via Radix Select, clicked THS-0001 marker -> map-property-popup-<id> rendered TWO separate sections: map-popup-mc-<id> ('MC PROPERTY | Property ID: THS-0001 | Verify Owner 1 | 9000000001') and map-popup-phed-<id> ('PHED LINKED DATA | Consumer ID: PROV-THS-0001 | Verify Owner 1'). Clicking view-phed-survey-<id> opened phed-map-survey-details dialog (NOT 'No survey data found'). All required testids present with expected values: map-mc-property-id='THS-0001', map-mc-owner-name='Verify Owner 1', map-mc-mobile='9000000001', map-mc-ward='Ward 1', map-phed-consumer-id='PROV-THS-0001', map-phed-consumer-name='Verify Owner 1', map-phed-survey-reference='PL0001', map-phed-survey-status='Submitted', map-phed-field-decision='Property Locked', map-phed-document-count='0 survey document(s) attached', map-mc-property-details + map-phed-details + map-phed-consumer-data sections rendered. Surveyor decision testid was absent (optional — survey has no explicit surveyor_decision string). No writes performed (no attach/unlink/submit/approve/reject invoked). At 390px with dialog CLOSED: page-level horizontal overflow = 0. At 390px with the PHED detail dialog OPEN: scrollWidth-clientWidth = 19px (minor page-level horizontal overflow caused by the details dialog width).

rca of the issue: Original bug (Iter 7-user-report): Map popup only rendered legacy MC fields and clicking View Survey called /submission/by-property, which returned nothing for pure-PHED properties -> 'No survey data found'. Main-agent fix: (1) get_map_properties enriches markers with linked phed_consumer fields; (2) admin Map.handleViewSurvey now independently fetches /api/phed/property/{id} and preferentially renders PhedMapSurveyDetails when a PHED survey or linked consumer exists, falling back to legacy submission otherwise; (3) popup now renders map-popup-mc-<id> and map-popup-phed-<id> as separate sections. Iter 8 confirms all three fixes end-to-end; the /submission/by-property misroute is no longer reachable for THS-0001.
